title: Bands are smooth but the gap differs from the reference
symptom: The smoothness and localization gates pass, but the GW gap differs from the trusted reference by more than the tolerance (default 0.2 eV).
evidence_required: trusted reference value and its source

candidate_experiments.action: fail the trial and branch back to the EXX/GW layer rules
candidate_experiments.expected_improvement: prevents accepting a smooth but physically wrong result
candidate_experiments.guard: the reference must be trusted; 0.2 eV is the default tolerance

stop_condition: The gap matches within tolerance or a layer cause is found.
